name: Golden Coast Saga
source:
The main character of the game, through whose eyes we see the story, lives in a poor area of the beautiful tropical city of Las Palmas, located on an island in the middle of the ocean. Yes, it's beautiful here, but there's an even better place on the island - the prestigious area of Golden Coast. Every young ambitious resident of the city dreams of getting here, but it's not that easy. One day, the main character gets a chance to change his life - he and his friend are accepted into the posh Golden Coast College, where children from wealthy families study. Now, main character is surrounded by temptations, money, intrigues, dangers, and exciting adventures. And, of course, plenty of beautiful girls whose hearts he'll undoubtedly want to win over. How will the main character handle his fate? Will he be able to settle in Golden Coast and become part of high society? That’s for you to decide!

[From [url=https://cillian-girl.itch.io/golden-coast-saga]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
遊戲主角居住在熱帶海島城市拉斯帕爾馬斯一處貧困社區，我們將透過他的視角看到這一切。這裡的確很美，但島上還有更好的地方——富裕的黃金海岸區。城裡每個有抱負的年輕人都夢想住進去，但這絕非易事。

有一天，主角迎來了改變人生的機會：他和朋友被富人子女就讀的名門黃金海岸學院錄取。金錢、誘惑、陰謀、危險和精彩冒險隨之而來；當然，還有許多美麗女孩等著他去贏得芳心。主角會如何面對自己的命運？他能否在黃金海岸立足，躋身上流社會？由你決定！

[摘自[url=https://cillian-girl.itch.io/golden-coast-saga]Itch.io[/url]]
